title: Collinearly complete sets and finite subgroups from configurations of skew $n$-planes in $\mathbb P^{2n+1}_K$
summary: We study collinearly complete finite sets of points arising from configurations of pairwise skew $n$-planes in $\mathbb {P}^{2n+1}_K$. To such a configuration we associate a groupoid generated by the natural collinearity correspondences between the $n$-planes, and we investigate the geometry of its finite orbits. In characteristic zero, we prove a rigidity result for the case in which the associated group is finite cyclic.
